notes.title: Demo Update ver.0.98.20
notes.notes:
The following issues have been fixed in the demo.

[b]【ver.0.98.20】[/b]
[list]
[*] Moma remains squashed after warping.
[*] The relic [Strange Power] does not apply its effect correctly.
[*] The relic description screen in the crafting menu remains open..
[*] In the Magma area, using ALLSKIP while Hachi is moving causes progression to halt after the boss is defeated.
[*] In some language settings, text boxes do not appear during gameplay, causing progression to halt.
[*] Progression halts when negotiating at a specific shop.
[/list]
